It fails to earn more than a 4 on two independent grounds. First, residual capture: the stock re-rated +41.7% off its August base and +20.6% in the two sessions ending 09-04, but on Akeso's HARMONi-2 overall-survival win, a different catalyst that has already fired; the PDUFA itself has been public for over seven months and its own base-to-today run is only +12.6%, with roughly +11% left to a provenance-checked favorable resolution. Second, and more disqualifying for this lane, the skew runs the wrong way: approval delivers a narrow 2L label that cannot underwrite a $14.04B cap on a royalty-burdened in-licensed asset and opens an equity-raise window, while a CRL or adcom referral — live risk given HARMONi met PFS with OS only trending at HR 0.76 — impugns the 1L platform narrative that actually carries the valuation, giving a reference R:R of 0.35. The asymmetry the triage flagged as "arguably mispriced" is real but inverted; the genuinely unpriced item on this name is the HARMONi-3 squamous PFS and early OS interim guided to 2H-2026, which is the milestone worth watching rather than the November label decision. Gap to note: I did not confirm whether FDA has scheduled or ruled out an ODAC meeting for this BLA, which is the single input that would most move the downside probability.

verified.analysis: The event is genuinely real, dated, forward and non-macro - signed definitive agreement with a named counterparty, an S-4 on file since 2026-08-28, two shareholder votes and a Q4-2026 close still ahead, and hard break fees ($174m/$101m) - so G1 and G2 pass cleanly and this is not a fired catalyst. The flagged "52-week low, classic unloved-MoE de-rate" reads as a mispricing only if you take the naive 1.5401 x $34.94 = $53.81 figure, which double-counts a dividend SUPN holders never receive; the real reason SUPN sits at its low is that it is now a synthetic long on Indivior, which has itself de-rated ~10% since the announcement. Per the residual-capture rule the score is capped: run-up is -2.5% (nothing harvested) but remaining capture is ~0%, so what is left to own is the post-merger equity and $125m of unearned synergies, not the event - keep it on WATCH and only reconsider if SUPN drifts to a genuine 8-10%+ discount to the ratio into the vote.
